violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW BEEF PATTIES STORED ON TOP OF WRAPPED SANDWICHES IN THE 1-DOOR COUNTER TOP COOLER ON THE COOKLINE (17).
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: PIC RELOCATED THE RAW BEEF PATTIES.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control:OBSERVED PIZZAS NOT TIME STAMPED WITH THE START AND END TIMES.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CDI: PIC WROTE THE START AND END TIMES FOR THE PIZZAS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED PACKAGED FOODS ON THE FLOOR IN THE WALK IN FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ENSURE THE FOODS ARE LOCATED OFF OF THE FLOOR BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control (TPHC) with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): VARIOUS PIZZAS ON RACK, CHEESE DANISH IN DISPLAY, COOKED SALMON ON COOK LINE, MILK (ICE BATH - SMOOTHIE STATION)
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS WILL EMAIL PIC TPHC DOCUMENTATION FOR FOODS USING TIME. PLEASE MAINTAIN DOCUMENTATION AND PROPER PROCEDURES FOR FOODS USING TPHC.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: CHICKPEAS IN DEEP POT, RICE IN COVERED PANS, CREAM SAUCE IN DEEP CONTAINER IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO TRANSFER FOODS TO SMALLER PORTIONS, SHALLOW PANS AND PLACE INTO FREEZER FOR RAPID COOLING WHILE OCCASIONALLY STIRRING AND MONITORING COOLING FOODS. DO NOT COVERS FOODS UNTIL COOLED TO 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: Food Contact with Equipment & Utensils
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found stored in contact with soiled equipment or utensils: Cooked bacon was being stored in a ProFish container that previously stored raw tuna.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall only contact surfaces of equipment and utensils that are cleaned and sanitized or the food shall be in contact with only single-service items. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT THE CONTAINER THE BACON WAS BEING STORED IN, IS NOT ALLOWED FOR ANY USE OTHER THAN STORING THE RAW TUNA THAT CAME IN THE CONTAINER. DUE TO NOT BEING SURE IF THE CONTAINER WAS PROPERLY WASHED, RINSE AND SANITIZED, PIC THREW AWAY CONTAINER AND BACON THAT WAS BEING STORED INSIDE. VIM & VICTOR (Inspection Date: 08/11/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: tomato salsa sitting out on the counter was temping at 63F and yogurt sitting in a counter top storage unit in an ice bath was temping at 45F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THE CORRECT COLD HOLDING TEMPERATURE OF A MAXIMUM OF 41F. PIC MOVED THE TOMATO SALSA TO A COLD HOLDING UNIT TO COOL DOWN AND PIC HAD AN EMPLOYEE REDO THE ICE BATH FROM THE YOGURT.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. CFM ARRIVED TO THE FACILITY DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at bakery area is blocked by a rolling cabinet, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC MOVED THE ROLLING CABINET AWAY FROM THE HAND SINK. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC ABOUT KEEPING THE AREA AROUND ALL OF THE HANDSINKS CLEAR FOR ACCESSIBILITY.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Parasite Destruction
violations.observation: The following fish offered for service or sale in the ready-to-eat form was not frozen to ensure parasite destruction: tuna in the tuna poke bowl.
violations.corrective_action: Before service or sale in ready-to-eat form, raw or partially cooked fish shall be: 1) frozen and stored at a temperature of -4F or below for a minimum of 7 days in a freezer, or 2) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -31F or below for a minimum of 15 hours, or 3) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -4F or below for a minimum of 24 hours. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO CONTACT THEIR FISH SUPPLIER TO OBTAIN THE PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FOR THE TUNA. PIC WILL EMAIL A COPY TO EHS.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Equipment food-contact surfaces/utensils were not observed cleaned before any possible contamination. EHS observed a meat slicer with food debris on it. EHS also observed two dirty can openers.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO DISASSEMBLE THE MEAT SLICER AND PUT IT IN THE DISHWASHER. PIC ALSO PLACED THE CAN OPENERS IN THE DISH WASHER.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: shredded cheese and sliced cheese in unit #1
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO NOT DOUBLE STACK THE CONTAINERS IN THE PREP TOP COOLERS. PIC CORRECTED ON SITE.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 1) 2DR perp top cooler on the left side of the prep line; 2) 4DWR cooler; 3) 1DR glass display used for cheese.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC UNDERSTANDS TO PUT WORKING THERMOMETERS IN ALL COOLERS. PIC REPLACED THE BROKEN THERMOMETER FROM THE 2DR PREP TOP COOLER WITH A WORKING THERMOMETER.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Cutting Board, When to Resurface or Discard
violations.observation: The cutting board(s) along the prep top service lines are heavily scratched and scored. The food contact surface is no longer easily cleaned and sanitized due to condition.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces such as cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO REPLACE THE HEAVILY WORN TO ENSURE PROPER CLEANING AND SANITIZING.
